# source: installed glossaries.sty 4.9 user manual. \newglossaryentry and
# \newacronym declare; \gls, \Gls, \GLS and their plurals set an entry's text,
# an acronym's long form with its short one in parentheses at its first use
# and its short form after; the \acr commands set an acronym's forms,
# \glslink its own text and the resets forget the first use. The glossary
# lists need makeglossaries' external run, so \printglossaries is named and
# not set; styles and other commands are not modelled.
pre inert:declares \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}
pre inert:declares \newglossaryentry{zzk}{name={kilo},description={a unit}}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\gls{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\Gls{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\GLS{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\glspl{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\Glspl{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\GLSpl{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrshort{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\Acrshort{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrlong{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\Acrlong{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrfull{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\Acrfull{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrshortpl{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrlongpl{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\acrfullpl{zza}
body impl \newglossaryentry{zzk}{name={kilo},description={a unit}}\glsentryname{zzk}
body impl \newglossaryentry{zzk}{name={kilo},description={a unit}}\glsentrytext{zzk}
body impl \newglossaryentry{zzk}{name={kilo},description={a unit}}\glslink{zzk}{x}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\glsreset{zza}
body impl \newacronym{zza}{ZA}{Zulu Alpha}\glsunset{zza}
body inert:resets \glsresetall
pre inert:lists \makeglossaries
body refuse:W0104 \printglossaries
body refuse:W0104 \printglossary
body refuse:W0104 \printacronyms
body refuse:W0301 \glsadd{zzk}
body refuse:W0301 \setacronymstyle{long-short}
